confirmation.offer_text: That sounds like a file request. I can build {format} you can download and share (takes about two minutes), or just answer right here in chat. Want the file?
confirmation.offer_text_gist: Sounds like you want {format} {gist}. Building the real file takes about two minutes, or I can just lay it out right here in chat. Want the file?
confirmation.teaser_text: Want this as a real downloadable file?
confirmation.lane_question_text: Sounds like you want a project plan file{gist}. Quick question before I build: do you want my structured plan workbook (four tabs: a Gantt timeline, a slip history of how due dates moved, a receipts sheet quoting the meeting line behind every value, and a progress curve drawn to the data date), or a custom spreadsheet composed just for what you described? Say workbook or custom.

upsell.text: If you were a {tier} subscriber, I could generate a Word or Excel file for you.

chat._note: Current client values, served so they can change without a release. context_window_fallback_tokens is the first one to tune: 32000 is wrong for most models we route to today, and it silently caps how much fits in project chat. Image sizing is NOT here on purpose: it is already served per tier at tiers.feature_definitions.images, and a second source for the same field is how the free-tier copy drifted.
